title: Add stub DXR modules (ASBuilder, Pipeline, SBT) and wire into CMake
purpose: Resolve compile/link issues by providing minimal class definitions used by App.cpp, enabling incremental DXR implementation.

steps.detail: Create src/dxr/ASBuilder.h/.cpp with minimal CreateTriangleBLAS and BuildTLAS stubs that allocate dummy buffers and return success.
Create src/dxr/Pipeline.h/.cpp with minimal DXR Pipeline class exposing AddDXILLibrary/AddHitGroup/SetShaderConfig/SetPipelineConfig/SetGlobalRootSignature/Create.
Create src/dxr/SBT.h/.cpp with minimal SBT class to set raygen/miss/hit records and provide a DispatchRaysDesc.
Update CMakeLists.txt to compile and link the new files; add include directories for src/dxr.

acceptance: Project compiles and links; DXR code paths compile even if not fully functional
App runs and falls back gracefully if DXR not fully set up
